files.title: Purge files

tasks.title: Purge tasks

purge.result: {count, plural, one {# item deleted.} other {# items deleted.}}

purgeNotifications.title: Purge notifications
purgeNotifications.description: All push notifications for all users will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

sms.title: Test SMS / WhatsApp sending
sms.success: Test SMS / WhatsApp message sent successfully
sms.help: Sends a test message through Sent.dm to check the configuration. Number in E.164 format (+33…). Remember to save your changes before testing.

weeklySummary.title: Test the weekly summary email
weeklySummary.help: Immediately sends next week's summary to your email address. Remember to save your changes before testing.

email.title: Test the email connection
email.help: Sends a test email to check the configuration. Remember to save your changes before testing.

sentDm.title: Sent.dm templates to create on their dashboard
sentDm.intro: Sign in to <link>app.sent.dm</link> and create the template below, then copy its UUID into the “Sent.dm template ID” field.
sentDm.createWith: Create a Sent.dm template with five variables:

vars.appName: {variable}: application name (white label, from the Application title setting)

sentDm.outro: Once it has been created and approved by Sent.dm (and WhatsApp if enabled), copy the template UUID from the Sent.dm dashboard and paste it into the Sent.dm template ID field above.

apiKeys.intro: API keys let external tools (automations, scripts, integrations) communicate with the planning through the REST API. Each request must include the Authorization: Bearer your_key header. The secret key is shown only once, when it is created.
apiKeys.created: Key created — copy it now, it will not be shown again
apiKeys.copiedClose: I have copied my key, close

confirmDelete.title: Delete the API key
confirmDelete.description: Are you sure you want to delete the “{name}” key? External tools using this key will be disconnected immediately.

howItWorks.title: How the cache works
howItWorks.description: The server cache keeps frequently read data in memory (application settings, user permissions) so that the database is not queried on every request. The data is refreshed automatically after the configured lifetime. The cache is also invalidated immediately when an administrator changes the settings or the roles.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke the MCP key
confirmRevoke.description: Are you sure you want to revoke the “{name}” key belonging to {user}? The AI assistant connected with this key will be disconnected immediately.

mcpGuide.title: Connect an AI assistant
mcpGuide.intro: The MCP server lets AI assistants interact with your planning: view tasks, create tasks, see projects and more. Actions are carried out with the permissions of the signed-in user.
mcpGuide.oauthInfo: Claude, ChatGPT and OAuth clients: add a custom connector with the URL below, without a key. The user is redirected to the sign-in page, then grants access.
mcpGuide.manualInfo: Manually configured clients: the user generates an MCP key from My account > AI and passes it in the Authorization header.

claude.note: Leave the OAuth fields empty. Claude opens the application's sign-in page: username, password (and 2FA if enabled), then “Allow”.

claudeCode.withKey: Or, with an MCP key (without OAuth), passed in the Authorization header:

chatgpt.devMode: Requires Developer mode to be enabled in ChatGPT.
chatgpt.createApp: Create an MCP app with this URL:
chatgpt.oauth: Choose OAuth authentication: ChatGPT opens the application's sign-in page, then the authorisation screen.

vscode.add: Add to the VS Code MCP settings:

jetbrains.path: Settings > Tools > AI Assistant > MCP. HTTP tab:

other.title: Other MCP clients
other.remote: Remote (HTTP): use the server URL. OAuth-compatible clients connect automatically through the authorisation page.
other.bearer: Bearer token: for clients that support headers, pass your MCP key:
other.noQueryToken: A key passed in the URL (?token=) is not accepted: the MCP specification forbids it because it would end up in logs. If the client does not allow headers, use the OAuth connection.

mcpGuide.prerequisite: Prerequisite: the user must have the mcp:use permission in their role (granted by default to the Manager and Administrator roles). Active keys are managed in My account > AI.

backup.keyHelp: Add BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY to your .env file to enable backups. Use a string of 32 or more characters.
backup.warning: Warning: downloaded files (.dump) are not encrypted and contain all of your data (users, hashed passwords, projects, tasks…). Keep them somewhere safe and do not share them.

confirmDelete.title: Delete the backup
confirmDelete.description: Permanently delete {filename}? The encrypted file will be removed from the server.

backupStep.unencrypted: This file is not encrypted and contains all of your data. Keep it somewhere safe.
backupStep.error: Unable to create or download the backup.

socket.title: Socket.io — Real time
socket.notResponding: {error} — The Socket.io server (port 3001) is not responding. Check that bun --hot server.ts is running.
socket.description: The Socket.io server provides real-time planning updates, the presence bar and session notifications between all connected users.

import.title: Import a database
import.intro: This tool restores data from a backup file (.dump) generated by Humble Planning.

mergeMode.title: Merge mode
mergeMode.description: Adds the new data from the file without touching existing data. Conflicting records are skipped.

replaceMode.title: Replace mode
replaceMode.description: Replaces the whole database with the content of the file. A safety backup will be required before the operation.

import.analysisNote: The file is analysed before any change: you will see a summary of its content and of any conflicts, then choose the import mode.
import.dropHint: or click to select a Humble Planning backup file
import.analyzingDetail: Validation, temporary restore and data analysis
import.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# conflict detected} other {# conflicts detected}} — some identifiers already exist in the current database.

merge.title: Merge without overwriting
merge.nothing: No new data to import. Every entry in the dump already exists.
merge.description: Adds only the new data. Existing records are kept unchanged.

replace.title: Replace the whole database
replace.description: Deletes all current data and replaces it. A backup will be required first.

import.executingDetail: Do not close this page. The operation may take several minutes.
import.success: Import successful ({mode, select, merge {merge} other {full replacement}})
import.sessionsInvalidated: All sessions have been invalidated. Redirecting to the sign-in page…

replaceDialog.title: Full database replacement
replaceDialog.description: All current data will be deleted and replaced. You must back up your data first.

migration.title: Migration from an external tool
migration.intro: Select the planning software you want to migrate your data from into Humble Planning.

soplanning.title: SoPlanning migration
soplanning.intro: This tool imports the data of a SoPlanning export (versions 1.55, 1.56 and 1.57, including patch releases) into Humble Planning. The import will replace all existing data.

notes.passwords: Passwords cannot be transferred — a single password will be generated for all imported users
notes.changePassword: All users will have to change their password the first time they sign in
notes.roles: SoPlanning rights will be converted into Humble Planning roles
notes.superAdmin: A super administrator account “{login}” will be created automatically
notes.backup: A backup of the current database will be required before the migration

soplanning.dropHint: or click to select the SoPlanning export archive
soplanning.analyzingDetail: Extracting the archive, checking the version and analysing the CSV data
soplanning.analysisTitle: Analysis of the SoPlanning v{version} export
soplanning.executingDetail: Replacing the database and importing the SoPlanning data

credentials.title: Sign-in credentials
credentials.warning: Write this information down before continuing. It will not be shown again.
credentials.usersPasswordHelp: All users will have to change this password the next time they sign in.

reviewRoles.title: Review roles and permissions
reviewRoles.description: SoPlanning's rights system has been converted automatically into HumblePlanning's roles and permissions, but the mapping is not perfect. We recommend reviewing each user and the roles created so that permissions match the real needs of your organisation. Go to Roles and then Users to complete this configuration.

finalizeDialog.title: Have you saved the credentials?
finalizeDialog.credentialsHidden: The password of the imported users and the super administrator credentials will never be shown again.
finalizeDialog.logout: When you finalise the migration, all users will be signed out, including you. You will then have to sign in again with the super administrator account.
finalizeDialog.confirm: I have written down the credentials, finalise

replaceDialog.title: SoPlanning migration — Full replacement
replaceDialog.description: This operation will permanently delete all current Humble Planning data and replace it with the SoPlanning data.

APP_BASE_URL.label: Application URL
APP_BASE_URL.description: Used in emails (password reset links, notifications)

TIMEZONE.label: Time zone
TIMEZONE.description: Determines how dates and times are displayed in the application

APP_LOCALE.label: Default language
APP_LOCALE.description: Language used when users have not chosen a language in their browser. Also used for emails sent to users who have never signed in.

MODULE_VEHICLES.label: Enable the Vehicles module
MODULE_VEHICLES.description: When disabled, the Vehicles button in the planning and the /vehicles and /vehicle-types pages become unavailable.

MODULE_RESOURCES.label: Enable the Resources module
MODULE_RESOURCES.description: When disabled, the Resources button in the planning and the /resources and /resource-types pages become unavailable.

MAINTENANCE_MODE.label: Maintenance mode
MAINTENANCE_MODE.description: Turns on maintenance mode for the planning. Users without the 'maintenance:bypass' permission will no longer be able to access the planning.

DEFAULT_HOME_PAGE.label: Default home page
DEFAULT_HOME_PAGE.description: These settings are applied when an account is created. Each user can then change them in their profile.

DEFAULT_SMS_NOTIFICATIONS.label: SMS / WhatsApp notifications enabled by default

PLANNING_MIN_CELL_WIDTH.label: Minimum cell width (px)
PLANNING_MIN_CELL_WIDTH.description: Lower bound of the width slider in the planning.

PLANNING_MAX_CELL_WIDTH.label: Maximum cell width (px)
PLANNING_MAX_CELL_WIDTH.description: Upper bound of the slider. Must be greater than the minimum width.

PLANNING_DEFAULT_CELL_WIDTH.label: Default cell width (px)
PLANNING_DEFAULT_CELL_WIDTH.description: Width applied the first time a user signs in (before they touch the slider). Must be between the minimum and maximum widths.

PLANNING_MAX_CELL_WIDTH_MOBILE.label: Maximum cell width on mobile (px)
PLANNING_MAX_CELL_WIDTH_MOBILE.description: Cap applied automatically on screens narrower than 768 px, even if the user has set a wider value with the slider.

PLANNING_SIDEBAR_WIDTH.label: Width of the names / projects column
PLANNING_SIDEBAR_WIDTH.description: "auto" to fit the content, or a value in pixels (e.g. 200). In auto mode, the column widens to show the longest name.

PLANNING_SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE.label: Maximum names / projects width (mobile)
PLANNING_SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE.description: Maximum width in pixels on mobile (< 768 px). Limits the column in auto mode to keep it readable.

PLANNING_FONT_FAMILY.label: Task font
PLANNING_FONT_FAMILY.description: Fonts hosted locally (loaded at build time). No calls to an external server.

PLANNING_FONT_BOLD.label: Bold task text
PLANNING_FONT_BOLD.description: Applies a semi-bold weight (600) instead of normal (400).

DEFAULT_NB_MONTHS_DISPLAYED.label: Number of months displayed by default

PLANNING_MAX_TASKS_PER_DAY.label: Maximum number of tasks per user per day
PLANNING_MAX_TASKS_PER_DAY.description: 0 = no limit. Shared by the day and hour views: prevents creating an extra task if the user has already reached this limit on the target day.

DURATION_DAY.label: Working day length (calculated automatically)
DURATION_DAY.description: Calculated from the morning and afternoon hours

INCLUDE_WEEKENDS.label: Include Saturdays and Sundays in calculations
INCLUDE_WEEKENDS.description: When enabled, weekends count as working days for the occupancy calculation

INCLUDE_HOLIDAYS.label: Include public holidays in calculations
INCLUDE_HOLIDAYS.description: When enabled, public holidays count as working days for the occupancy calculation

ANNOUNCEMENT_ENABLED.label: Show an announcement
ANNOUNCEMENT_ENABLED.description: Displays a floating banner on every planning page

ANNOUNCEMENT_EXPIRES_AT.label: Show until
ANNOUNCEMENT_EXPIRES_AT.description: Leave empty to display it permanently

ANNOUNCEMENT_REPEAT.label: Announcement repetition
ANNOUNCEMENT_REPEAT.description: Shows the announcement again automatically to users who closed it

NUNTLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.label: Nuntly webhook secret
NUNTLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret used to verify webhooks (prefixed with whsec_)

SENT_API_KEY.label: Sent.dm API key
SENT_API_KEY.description: Get your API key and sender ID at https://app.sent.dm. The user's mobile phone number is used to send notifications.

SENT_TEMPLATE_ID.label: Sent.dm template ID
SENT_TEMPLATE_ID.description: UUID of the template to use. The template must be created at https://app.sent.dm with five variables: {v1} (application name), {v2} (event type), {v3} (project name), {v4} (task title) and {v5} (application URL)

SENT_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.label: Default country
SENT_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. FR, BE, CH) used for the flag selector in phone fields

EMAIL_SEND_DELAY.label: Delay before sending (seconds)
EMAIL_SEND_DELAY.description: Waiting time before sending, to group quick successive changes

EMAIL_THROTTLE_DELAY.label: Delay between emails (seconds)
EMAIL_THROTTLE_DELAY.description: Pause between each send to limit throughput (0 = no delay)

EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGERS.label: Trigger events
EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGERS.description: Select the events that trigger a notification email

WEEKLY_SUMMARY_ENABLED.label: Enable the weekly summary email
WEEKLY_SUMMARY_ENABLED.description: Automatically sends a summary email of the coming week's tasks (Monday → next Sunday) to every user with email notifications enabled. If a user has no scheduled task, no email is sent.

PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGERS.label: Trigger events (push)
PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGERS.description: Select the events that trigger an in-app push notification

__purge_notifications.description: Deletes every push notification for every user. This action cannot be undone.

NOTIFICATION_SMS_ENABLED.label: SMS / WhatsApp notifications enabled
NOTIFICATION_SMS_ENABLED.description: The user's mobile phone number is used for sending. Messages are routed automatically by Sent.dm to WhatsApp when available, otherwise by SMS.

SMS_THROTTLE_DELAY.label: Delay between SMS messages (seconds)
SMS_THROTTLE_DELAY.description: Pause between each send to limit throughput (0 = no delay)

SMS_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGERS.label: Trigger events (SMS / WhatsApp)
SMS_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGERS.description: Select the events that trigger an SMS / WhatsApp message

PWD_HISTORY_COUNT.label: Prevent reuse of the last X passwords

PWD_GEN_INCLUDE_SPECIAL.label: Include special characters in generated passwords

PWD_BLACKLIST_ENABLED.label: Enable the banned password list
PWD_BLACKLIST_ENABLED.description: Prevents the use of the passwords in the list below

FORGOT_PASSWORD_ENABLED.label: Enable the “Forgotten password” feature
FORGOT_PASSWORD_ENABLED.description: Shows a link on the sign-in page that lets users reset their password by email. Requires the email settings (SMTP or Mailgun) to be configured.

BRUTEFORCE_LOCKOUT_SECONDS.label: Lockout duration (seconds)
BRUTEFORCE_LOCKOUT_SECONDS.description: Waiting time imposed after the number of failed attempts (e.g. 300 = 5 minutes)

TWOFACTOR_REQUIRED.label: Require 2FA for all users
TWOFACTOR_REQUIRED.description: When enabled, every user will have to set up two-factor authentication to sign in

SESSION_DURATION_DAYS.label: Session duration (days)
SESSION_DURATION_DAYS.description: How long a user session remains valid. The session is renewed automatically on each visit.

SESSION_REMEMBER_DAYS.label: “Stay signed in” duration (days)
SESSION_REMEMBER_DAYS.description: Session duration when the user ticks “Stay signed in” on the sign-in page

CAPTCHA_ENABLED.label: Enable captcha
CAPTCHA_ENABLED.description: Adds a captcha check to the sign-in and password reset pages

CAPTCHA_SITE_KEY.label: Site key
CAPTCHA_SITE_KEY.description: Public key supplied by the captcha provider

CAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY.label: Secret key
CAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY.description: Private key used for server-side verification

LEGAL_COMPANY_NAME.label: Company / controller name
LEGAL_COMPANY_NAME.description: Variable: {variable} — Insert this variable in the policy content to display this name automatically.

LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL.label: DPO / GDPR contact email
LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Variable: {variable} — Insert this variable in the policy content to display this email address automatically.

LEGAL_DATA_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Data retention period (days)
LEGAL_DATA_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Variable: {variable} — Insert this variable in the policy content. Displayed in days.

FOOTER_COPYRIGHT_TEXT.label: Copyright text
FOOTER_COPYRIGHT_TEXT.description: E.g. © 2026 MyCompany. Displayed at the bottom of the side menu.

FOOTER_SHOW_PRIVACY_LINK.label: Show the Privacy link in the menu

MAX_FILES_PER_TASK.label: Maximum number of files per task

LOGS_ENABLED.label: Enable system logs
LOGS_ENABLED.description: Records system events (errors, actions, sign-ins) in an in-memory buffer that can be viewed on the Logs page

LOGS_MAX_ENTRIES.label: Maximum number of entries
LOGS_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Size of the in-memory circular buffer (the oldest entries are replaced)

API_ENABLED.label: Enable API access
API_ENABLED.description: Lets external tools communicate with the planning using API keys

API_RATE_LIMIT_MINUTE.label: Requests per minute
API_RATE_LIMIT_MINUTE.description: Maximum number of API requests per key per minute

API_RATE_LIMIT_HOUR.label: Requests per hour
API_RATE_LIMIT_HOUR.description: Maximum number of API requests per key per hour

API_RATE_LIMIT_EXPORT.label: Exports per minute
API_RATE_LIMIT_EXPORT.description: Maximum number of exports (CSV, Excel, PDF, iCal) per key per minute

CACHE_ENABLED.label: Enable the server cache
CACHE_ENABLED.description: Caches settings and permissions in memory to reduce database queries

CACHE_TTL.label: Cache lifetime (seconds)
CACHE_TTL.description: Time before cached data is refreshed automatically. 300 = 5 minutes.

_purge_files.description: Permanently deletes every file uploaded before the selected date. This action cannot be undone.

_purge_tasks.description: Permanently deletes every task whose start date is before the selected date (including their attached files). This action cannot be undone.

MCP_ENABLED.label: Enable the MCP server
MCP_ENABLED.description: Lets AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) interact with the planning through the MCP protocol

MCP_MAX_KEYS_PER_USER.label: Maximum number of MCP keys per user
MCP_MAX_KEYS_PER_USER.description: Each user can generate this number of keys from their profile

BACKUP_ENABLED.label: Automatic backups
BACKUP_ENABLED.description: Turns on automatic database backups at the configured frequency

BACKUP_TIME.label: Target time
BACKUP_TIME.description: Time at which the automatic backup starts

UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED.label: Check for updates
UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED.description: The server queries the public GitHub Releases API (api.github.com) at most once every 24 hours, or when you click “Check now”. Only this read request is sent: no data about the instance or its users. When disabled, no request is made, neither automatic nor manual.
